All 22 state coaching pages render with an undefined state: empty H1, canonical /coaching/nata-coaching-in-undefined, and any slug returns an indexable 200
rootCause: The folder name mixes a static prefix and a dynamic segment (nata-coaching-in-[state]). Next 14.2 only supports a whole-segment [param]; the route regex drops the prefix, so params.state is undefined.
evidence: curl https://neramclasses.com/coaching/nata-coaching-in-tamil-nadu on 2026-09-24: 200, <title>Best NATA Coaching in  2026 ... | Neram Classes | Neram Classes</title>, rel=canonical https://neramclasses.com/coaching/nata-coaching-in-undefined.
impact: All 22 state hubs (linked from home, footer and every city page, and listed in the sitemap) tell Google their canonical is a single nonexistent URL, so none can rank for 'NATA coaching in <state>'. Arbitrary URLs create soft-404 duplicates.
fix: Move the page to coaching/state/[state] (or coaching/[stateSlug] with a lookup), add a rewrite from /coaching/nata-coaching-in-:state, set dynamicParams=false or notFound() for unknown states, and keep the public URL unchanged.
risk: Low. URL stays the same through the rewrite; check the redirect list in next.config.js does not catch it first.
expected: 22 state hubs become indexable with correct titles and canonicals.

history.note: uncommitted 2026-09-25; unit tests in apps/marketing/src/lib/seo/state-coaching-slug.test.ts; localhost: tamil-nadu 200 with correct canonical, goa 404

title: Captured Razorpay payments are never reconciled when the browser drops before verify runs (no webhook in any app)
location: apps/marketing/src/app/api/payment (no webhook route); callers components/apply/PaymentDialog.tsx:409, pay/PaymentPage.tsx:255
rootCause: Payment state moves to paid only from the client-called verify route. There is no Razorpay webhook handler and no reconciliation cron, and the client does not retry verify.
evidence: No *webhook* route under apps/*/src/app/api. PaymentDialog shows 'contact support' on a verify failure with no retry.
impact: A student whose network drops after paying is charged but stays pending; staff reconcile by hand.
fix: Add /api/webhooks/razorpay verifying X-Razorpay-Signature, handling payment.captured/order.paid through one idempotent markPaid shared with verify; retry verify with backoff on the client and show the Razorpay payment id.
risk: Medium: touches payments; needs the webhook secret in Vercel env and the Razorpay dashboard.

robots.txt disallows /_next/, so Google cannot fetch the CSS and JS it needs to render pages
rootCause: A Disallow: /_next/ rule copied from a generic template.
impact: Googlebot renders pages without styles or client JS, which hurts mobile-friendliness and page-experience evaluation and can hide client-rendered content.
fix: Delete the /_next/ line. Keep /api/ disallowed.
expected: Google renders pages as users see them.

impact: A Chennai money page is dead and several internal links point to a 404.
fix: Exclude best-* from the negative lookahead (or delete the page and redirect it to the chosen Chennai canonical, see the cannibalisation finding), and fix the links.

title: /logo.png and /og-default.png return 404, so every Organization, Article and LocalBusiness schema has a broken logo and social shares fall back to an SVG
rootCause: The constants point at files that are not in public/.
impact: The logo is not eligible for the knowledge panel and rich results; WhatsApp, Facebook and LinkedIn previews show no image.
fix: Add a 512x512 PNG logo and a 1200x630 PNG default OG image to public/ and point the constants at them.
expected: Valid logo in schema; image previews when parents share links on WhatsApp.

title: Keyword cannibalisation: three separate city page systems (about 8 pages for Chennai alone) compete for the same 'NATA coaching in <city>' searches
rootCause: City pages were added in waves (System A /nata-coaching/{city}, System B /coaching/nata-coaching/nata-coaching-centers-in-{city}, Chennai neighbourhoods) with no single canonical per city. Both A and B also emit the same LocalBusiness @id.
impact: Google splits signals between near-duplicates and often ranks none of them on page 1.
fix: One URL per city: keep /coaching/nata-coaching/nata-coaching-centers-in-{city} as the city canonical (it has the widest coverage), 301 the 14 System A pages into it after merging their unique content, keep /contact/{slug} for real centres, and keep the Chennai neighbourhood pages as children linking up to the Chennai hub.
risk: Medium: 301s cost a few weeks of ranking fluctuation. Do it once, together with the content upgrade.

title: Hard-coded self-serving AggregateRating (4.8 from 2,500 and 4.9 from 90) on Organization, LocalBusiness and Course schema with no review source
rootCause: Rating numbers typed into schema builders instead of being computed from stored reviews.
evidence: /nata-online-coaching emits two Course schemas with different ratings (4.9/90 and 4.8/2,500).
impact: Google ignores self-serving ratings on Organization/LocalBusiness and treats unverifiable ones as a structured-data manual-action risk, which can remove all rich results site-wide.
fix: Remove every hard-coded aggregateRating. Only emit ratings on Course from real, on-page reviews (the testimonials table), computed at build.
risk: Low. Star snippets were not being shown anyway.
expected: No manual-action risk; cleaner entity signals.

title: Every page view fires three uncached client fetches to /api/marketing-content, and two banners that load above the header shift the layout
rootCause: Three layout widgets each fetch the same endpoint from the browser. The route sets s-maxage=3600, but next.config applies CDN-Cache-Control: no-store to all /api/* (deliberately, for per-user safety), which Vercel's edge honours, so each call runs a function and a Supabase query.
evidence: Code read; request count per page not measured with a HAR.
impact: About 3 function invocations and 3 DB reads per page view site-wide, plus CLS from banners appearing above the header after load.
fix: Fetch marketing content once on the server in the [locale] layout through a cached query (unstable_cache, revalidate 3600, tag for admin revalidation) and pass it to the three widgets as props. This removes the client fetches entirely and keeps the /api no-store rule intact.
risk: Low. Admin edits need revalidateTag or the 1h TTL.
expected: -3 function invocations per page view; no banner layout shift.

history.note: Partly fixed 2026-09-25: Vercel-CDN-Cache-Control on 5 public content routes (test guards auth routes). Still open: banner CLS; server render conflicts with static pages

title: The root client bundle on every page carries Firebase (via the @neram/auth barrel), Fuse plus a 100KB search index (via the Header), and the Tawk.to chat script
location: components/AuthProvider.tsx:4 -> packages/auth/src/index.ts; components/Header.tsx:40 -> lib/search-index.ts:1-2,771; GeneralChatbot.tsx:375 -> TawkToChat.tsx:75-81
rootCause: Eager top-level imports in layout-level client components. The search index builds its Fuse index at module load. Tawk mounts hidden as soon as the chatbot mounts.
evidence: Live HTML is about 400-560KB with 39 script tags (measured by the SEO pass). First-load JS per route not measured (no build run).
impact: Slower LCP and INP on mid-range Android phones, which are most of the audience; this weighs on Core Web Vitals for every ranking page.
fix: dynamic() import SearchDialog on first open (build the Fuse index lazily); import firebase from a subpath (@neram/auth/firebase) and initialise it only when a sign-in UI opens; load Tawk only when the user asks for a human.
risk: Low to medium: the AuthProvider change needs a check that signed-in state still restores on pages that need it.
expected: Smaller first-load JS on every page; better mobile LCP and INP.

title: The /nata-2026 hero is sent in the HTML at opacity 0 and only appears after hydration
location: components/nata/sections/HeroSection.tsx:104-107,174-177; the home h1 also fades from opacity 0 over 0.9s (hero/NewHeroSection.tsx:70-79)
rootCause: framer-motion initial={{opacity:0}} with whileInView on the LCP element.
impact: The LCP element waits for JS download and hydration, which is several seconds on a mid-range phone on 4G.
fix: Render the hero statically visible; keep motion only on below-the-fold sections and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
expected: LCP moves to first paint on the NATA 2026 hub and home.

history.note: uncommitted; hero h1/subtitle visible at first paint; global prefers-reduced-motion rule added

title: /colleges, /colleges/[state] and the NIRF ranking page render on every request with no-store count queries and no loading state
rootCause: searchParams reads and force-dynamic make the pages dynamic, and createServerClient forces cache:no-store, so revalidate has no effect. There is no loading.tsx.
impact: Every visit costs a function invocation plus about 8 queries, including count:'exact'. The screen stays blank until the server finishes.
fix: Move filters to the client over a cached base list (or cache per filter with unstable_cache), drop force-dynamic, use createAdminClientISR, count:'estimated', add loading.tsx skeletons, and dedupe generateMetadata with React cache.
expected: Colleges pages served from ISR; fewer DB reads.

title: The YouTube channel-stats route is force-dynamic, so each view spends about 100 YouTube API quota units with no timeout
rootCause: force-dynamic overrides revalidate=3600; search.list costs 100 units per call.
impact: Quota runs out after about 100 views a day, after which mock numbers are shown silently.
fix: Drop force-dynamic, cache with unstable_cache for 1h, use the channel id from env instead of search.list, add AbortSignal.timeout(5000).
expected: About 24 quota calls a day instead of one per view.

title: AI chat routes call Gemini with no timeout and no maxDuration
rootCause: fetch without AbortSignal; the chat route loops up to 3 tool iterations plus a final call, each with model fallbacks.
impact: A slow model hangs the function to the platform limit and the user sees a spinner that never resolves.
fix: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) in gemini.ts and export const maxDuration = 60 on the five routes; show a retry in the chat UI.
risk: Low. The packages/ai change deploys all apps.

title: capture-phone calls .catch() on a Supabase query builder, which throws, so the funnel event is never written
rootCause: PostgREST builders are thenables with no .catch method.
impact: Phone-capture funnel data is lost and the route reports captured:false.
fix: const { error } = await db.from(...).insert(...); log the error; check the phone update error at line 58.

title: Enrolment completion is not atomic: a double submit or two tabs can create two student profiles
rootCause: The link is checked early and marked used only at the end; users.user_type is set before the profile exists.
impact: Duplicate student records that later need a manual merge.
fix: Claim the link first with update({status:'used'}).eq('status','active').select() and abort on 0 rows; move the user update after the profile insert.

title: 404s render outside the site layout: the root not-found has no <html>/<body> and there is no [locale]/not-found
rootCause: next-intl pattern puts html/body in [locale]/layout; the root not-found renders a bare div.
impact: 404 pages lose the header, footer and navigation, so the visitor has nowhere to go and the document may be invalid.
fix: Add [locale]/not-found.tsx inside the layout with links to NATA coaching, city finder and search; give the root not-found its own html/body.
expected: 404s keep the visitor on the site.

title: hreflang alternates point at locale versions that are noindexed
rootCause: buildAlternates emits ta/hi/kn/ml for every page regardless of whether that locale is indexable.
evidence: Code read plus live pages checked by the SEO pass.
impact: Conflicting signals; Google Search Console reports hreflang errors and may ignore the whole cluster.
fix: Emit alternates only for locales that are indexable for that route (en plus ta/hi where real translations exist) and add x-default.

history.note: uncommitted 2026-09-25; unit tests in apps/marketing/src/lib/seo/indexable-locales.test.ts (guards drift from next.config.js)

title: Templated city pages with only the name swapped, some claiming a local centre that does not exist
location: packages/database/src/data/location-seo-content.ts (unique content for 40 cities only); nata-coaching/[slug] template text 'our {city} center is equipped with modern facilities'
rootCause: Programmatic pages fall back to a template for about 43 indexed medium-priority cities.
impact: Doorway-page and helpful-content risk that can suppress the whole city cluster; misleading claims damage trust.
fix: Only index a city page with unique content (local colleges, exam centres, travel time, local toppers, fee in local context). Say 'online' plainly where there is no centre. Noindex the rest until written.

title: Public read API routes are force-dynamic with no cache headers
location: line 1 of each route (export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic')
rootCause: force-dynamic added by default to every route.
impact: A function invocation and DB reads per call for data that changes daily at most.
fix: Serve these from Server Components with unstable_cache where possible; otherwise drop force-dynamic and cache the query server-side for 5 to 60 minutes.

title: Route handlers return 500 for auth failures and 200 for real errors
rootCause: Thrown auth errors fall into generic 500 catches; PostgrestError is not an Error so messages are lost; some catches return 200 with defaults.
impact: Expired sessions look like outages; real outages look like 'no data'.
fix: Typed AuthError mapped to 401/403; wrap PostgrestError; return 5xx on real errors.

title: Supabase write results unchecked in payment and enrolment routes
rootCause: Inserts and updates awaited without reading error; .single() treated any error as 'not found'.
impact: Silent partial enrolments (installment rows, student_profiles, fee_paid) of the kind already seen in direct enrolment.
fix: Check each error, use maybeSingle(), and fail loudly.

title: Outbound calls without timeouts and notifications awaited inline on the request path
rootCause: fetch and SDK calls without AbortSignal; emails and WhatsApp sent before responding; fire-and-forget calls without waitUntil.
impact: Forms feel slow or hang when Resend or Meta is slow; fire-and-forget work can be cut off.
fix: AbortSignal.timeout(8000) everywhere; move notifications to waitUntil from @vercel/functions.

title: The apply form can submit twice while a draft save is in flight, creating two applications
rootCause: Submit is not disabled while isSavingDraft; both POSTs pass hasExistingApplication.
impact: Duplicate leads for staff to clean up.
fix: Disable submit while saving; add a unique partial index on the server (needs approval).

title: The refund button never sends the auth header, so it always gets 401
rootCause: fetch without Authorization.
impact: Students cannot see an existing refund request.
fix: Add the Firebase bearer token.

title: Every page serialises the full translation bundle (53KB en, about 106KB ta) into the HTML
rootCause: NextIntlClientProvider receives all messages instead of the namespaces client components use.
evidence: Code read; live HTML size 400-560KB measured by the SEO pass.
impact: Heavier HTML and slower first paint on mobile.
fix: Pass only the namespaces client components use (pick(messages, [...])).
risk: Low; missing namespaces show as keys, so test each page.

title: Builds ignore type errors and functions have no region pinned near India
rootCause: Defaults.
evidence: Code read; the Vercel project region was not checked.
impact: Type errors can ship; dynamic pages and APIs pay a US round trip for Indian users (the DB region should be checked too).
fix: Turn off ignoreBuildErrors after a clean type-check; set regions to bom1 if the Supabase project is in ap-south-1.
risk: Region change: check DB location first.

title: The sitemap renders per request with four sequential DB queries and lists noindexed locale college URLs
rootCause: No-store admin client makes it dynamic; lastmod dates are hard-coded.
evidence: Live sitemap has 1,783 URLs (measured by the SEO pass).
impact: Slow sitemap fetches for crawlers; wrong lastmod reduces recrawl.
fix: revalidate = 86400 with createAdminClientISR, Promise.all, real lastmod from updated_at, drop noindexed locale URLs, add /testimonials and /achievements, and split into sitemaps by type (coaching, exam, colleges, blog).

history.note: Partly fixed 2026-09-25: noindexed locale college URLs, dead course URLs removed; /testimonials and /achievements added (1,783 live to 719 local). Still open: dynamic render, sequential queries, hard-coded lastmod

rootCause: No contextual links from the high-traffic exam guides to the money pages.

fix: Add a 'Prepare with Neram' block linking /nata-online-coaching and the nearest city hub on every NATA 2026 page; render visible breadcrumbs on coaching pages.

title: The colleges error boundary shows the error message and stack to users

title: Detail pages query twice per request (metadata and page) and the NATA 2026 hub runs two unused queries
rootCause: No React cache around shared fetchers; leftover queries.
impact: Double DB reads.
fix: Wrap the fetchers in React cache; delete the unused queries.

title: The SEO automation workflow checks stale /en/ URLs and submits a fixed list to IndexNow
rootCause: Written before the as-needed locale prefix and the coaching pages.
impact: PageSpeed never measures the coaching pages; IndexNow gets redirects.
fix: Point CWV checks at /, /nata-online-coaching, a city page and a state page; drop the IndexNow job (the daily cron already submits the sitemap) or make it submit changed URLs only.

title: Pages without their own alternates inherited the home page as their canonical from the [locale] layout
rootCause: A canonical set in a layout is inherited by every child page that does not override it.
evidence: curl on 2026-09-25: /nata-hub, /jee-barch-hub, /ask-seniors and /colleges/compare all served rel=canonical https://neramclasses.com.
impact: Google treats those pages as duplicates of the home page and drops them from the index.
fix: Remove the canonical from the layout; give each page its own through buildAlternates; the home page keeps its explicit canonical.
expected: Each page indexable on its own URL.

title: The About page team photos return 404 on production
rootCause: The page references photos that were never added to public/.
evidence: curl https://neramclasses.com/images/team/tamilselvan.jpg and sivaram.jpg return 404 on 2026-09-25; the same four 404 locally.
impact: Broken faculty images on the page that carries the site's expertise and trust signals (E-E-A-T).
fix: Add real faculty photos (square, WebP, about 400px) to public/images/team/, or render initials until photos exist.

title: Header menu links keyed by href collide (several link to /colleges), logging duplicate-key errors on every page
rootCause: key={link.href} while seven menu entries share href '/colleges'.
evidence: Playwright on localhost 2026-09-25: about 20 'Encountered two children with the same key /colleges' console errors per page; 0 after the fix.
impact: Console noise on every page; React may drop or duplicate menu items on update.
fix: Key by href plus label.
